plan.notes: Official 2026-2027 Major Map (recommended sequence) for the B.A. in English, McCausland College of Arts and Sciences, Dept. of English Language & Literature, from the USC Major Map Repository (2026_engl_map.pdf). All 8 semesters transcribed; semester sums verified against printed totals (15/15/16/16/15/15/15/13 at slot minimums = 120, matches Graduation Requirements Summary: 120 total, 30 major, 46-58 college/program, 32-44 Carolina Core, 2.000 GPA). Ranged slots transcribed at minimums with notes: Carolina Core ARP (3-4) at 3; Foreign language/other CC (3-4) at 3; English Major Course (3-6) at 3; 'Elective only if needed' (1-3) at 1. English major (30-33 hrs): 2 pre-1800 + 3 post-1800 literature courses + 5 ENGL electives 300+ (one linguistics overlay) + diversity course; 12-hr advanced cognate or 18+ hr minor; foreign language proficiency equivalent to the 122 course; one U.S. + one non-U.S. History required. Retrieved 2026-10-09.
